data.problem: Assess feasibility of bypassing Vercel AI SDK by mapping where OpenCode depends on AI SDK abstractions and identifying the smallest viable replacement path for Claude Agent SDK.
constraints: OpenCode uses AI SDK types (ModelMessage, Tool, StreamTextResult) across session/prompt/tooling flows.
Providers are instantiated via @ai-sdk/* packages in Provider.getLanguage and depend on LanguageModelV2.
Streaming relies on streamText/wrapLanguageModel middleware and ProviderTransform message/options mapping.
Claude Agent SDK already emits providerExecuted tool events that OpenCode bridges via AI SDK stream parts.

options.name: Feature-flagged Claude direct path
options.approach: Add a Claude-only stream path that calls @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk directly (bypassing streamText) while keeping AI SDK for all other providers. Reuse existing translate-prompt/stream adapters to minimize changes.
options.what_we_learn: Which AI SDK responsibilities must be re-implemented (middleware, tool repair, usage handling) for a single provider.
options.risk_if_wrong: Low; isolated to Claude path with a feature flag.

options.name: Introduce internal model interface
options.approach: Define an OpenCode-specific model interface and adapt AI SDK and Claude Agent SDK behind it, progressively migrating session/llm and tool flows.
options.what_we_learn: True surface area of AI SDK coupling and migration costs for other providers.

options.name: Full replacement of streamText pipeline
options.approach: Replace streamText/wrapLanguageModel with direct SDK streaming for all providers and re-implement middleware, tool calling, and reasoning extraction in OpenCode.
options.what_we_learn: Complete cost and feasibility of removing AI SDK entirely.
options.risk_if_wrong: High; broad changes across providers and tooling.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it isolates the bypass to Claude, yields fast feedback on AI SDK responsibilities, and is highly reversible.
